execution: uten_migrator/owner only; runtime cannot call raw snapshot or apply
numeric_preservation: Keep fn_employee_merge_source_snapshot(uuid)::text and canonical-before JSON::text as original PostgreSQL UTF-8 strings. Never parse/reserialize their NUMERIC fields through binary float.

typed_projection_shape.rows: original full PostgreSQL JSON rows with NULL/source UUID, never overwrite OTHER_UUID

plan_example_NOT_EXECUTABLE.database_identity: exact JSON from fn_employee_merge_database_identity(); driver separately pins physical system_identifier/runtime binding
plan_example_NOT_EXECUTABLE.canonical_row_sha256: SQL SHA256 of to_jsonb(current locked canonical employees row)::text
plan_example_NOT_EXECUTABLE.canonical_sensitive_sha256: required when canonical_patch nonempty: SQL SHA256 of COALESCE(to_jsonb(canonical_sensitive)::text,'null')
plan_example_NOT_EXECUTABLE.snapshot_enc: APP_KEY_VERSION:base64 PG-pgp encryption of that ORIGINAL snapshot text; actual confidential envelope never printed
plan_example_NOT_EXECUTABLE.preservation_reference: existing private GPG payload transfer_id/source_sid reference
plan_example_NOT_EXECUTABLE.preservation_sha256: independently RAM-verified private GPG/preimage receipt SHA256
plan_example_NOT_EXECUTABLE.evidence_reference: human same-person confirmation + per-field decision manifest reference
plan_example_NOT_EXECUTABLE.evidence_sha256: SHA256 of exact same-person/field decision evidence artifact
plan_example_NOT_EXECUTABLE.reason: Reviewed same-person consolidation; all conflicting original fields preserved encrypted
plan_example_NOT_EXECUTABLE.expected_epoch_delta: optional positive integer learned from complete ROLLBACK rehearsal; freeze identical body for COMMIT

canonical_patch_policy: Only manifest-approved correction. Preserve valid current primary document; never overwrite nonNULL primary legacy_id. SQL preserves primary status/department/code/all user credentials and hashes every changed document excluding only person UUID and update/version metadata.
batch_order: Lock all known source/canonical/user/sensitive business rows in deterministic order in one RR transaction. Source snapshots may be presealed independently; construct each canonical_version/rowSHA from the transaction's latest intended state after preceding same-group sources.
server_only_gpg_preimage: For every group seal full canonical-before snapshot plus each source snapshot ORIGINAL text, typed-reference/code audit and field decisions. Existing private payloads preserve complete old credentials; public receipts contain only UUID/code/counts/SHAs.
forbidden: raw PII/lookup HMAC/password in client review export
rewriting original source legacy integers or Sys_Operator roles
